The main takeaway from our work is that
the SUH routing approach is a useful tool for generating flood hydrographs in ungauging catchments and can be used to develop a regional unit hydrograph.
the SUH approach based flood hydrograph model with linear Muskingum model is a promising tool for flood forecasting and management in ungaugged catchments.
